# gitmoap_publisher (Data Source)

Get a publisher's public profile. The publisher's namespace, display name, contact email, public key, status, and whether and how it was verified. Which account owns a publisher is shown only to that account and to platform administrators. Open to any signed-in caller.

The token needs `publisher:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_publisher" "example" {
  publisher_id = "acme"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `publisher_id` (String) Publisher id

### Read-Only

- `contact_email` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `namespace` (String)
- `owner` (Attributes) Who did something — a person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — with what a
client needs to draw and link them, so a page of records names its actors without a lookup each. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner))
- `public_key` (String)
- `status` (String) Account status of a `Publisher`. `Active` publishers may submit; `Suspended`
is a platform-admin hold.
- `updated_at` (String)
- `verification_method` (String) How a publisher's `verified` flag was earned. `Manual` is the platform-admin
grant (D3); `Dns` / `Github` are the self-service namespace-ownership proofs.
- `verification_target` (String)
- `verified` (Boolean)
- `verified_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--owner"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owner`

Read-Only:

- `avatar_url` (String) The principal's picture, when one is known. Absent otherwise: a client derives the
deterministic avatar URL itself.
- `email` (String) The principal's address. An agent's is a generated no-reply address — the author of its
commits. `unknown` on a deleted actor and empty on a redacted one.
- `id` (String) The principal's id: a user id, a service account id or an agent id, as `kind` says. Empty on
a redacted actor.
- `kind` (String) A person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — which of the three a principal is,
and so which page it links to: a person's profile, a service account's page or an agent's page.
- `username` (String) The name to show: a person's or service account's username, or an agent's handle (which
always ends in `-ai`). `deleted-user` when the actor no longer resolves, `redacted` when the
caller may not see who it was. A closed account whose work stays is `closed-` and twelve hex
digits, a shape no open account may take, with an address under `.invalid`.
